chair.lede: We move the clock one second closer to midnight due to worsening health and climate crises, notably the Ebola death toll surpassing 5,000 and deadly floods in Syria.
body: The Congo Ebola outbreak has now exceeded 5,000 deaths, marking a severe escalation in a public health emergency that threatens broader regional spread.
Severe flooding in eastern Syria killed five children among seven victims, underscoring escalating climate‑related humanitarian risks.
While some positive steps were noted in nuclear deterrence and AI safety, the combined impact of the health and climate setbacks outweighs these gains for today.

experts.say: US approval of a $2.1 bn Patriot missile sale to Ukraine strengthens its air defence against Russian strikes (1) and may lower escalation risk, while Iran's NPT‑withdrawal talk raises concerns but no concrete nuclear move yet (11).
Severe flooding in eastern Syria killed children [2] and storm warnings across major Australian cities signal extreme weather impacts [7].
The Congo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,000 deaths, indicating a worsening public health crisis.[3][8]

Recent AI news includes the Pope urging an ethical framework for AI (4), OpenAI cutting its funding target which may curb rapid risky expansion (9), and OpenAI limiting weapons info for teens on ChatGPT to improve safety (19). These steps modestly reduce AI‑related risks.

US approval of a $2.1 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine heightens the arms race with Russia [1,6,18], while Iran’s aggressive actions in the Strait of Hormuz and calls to withdraw from the NPT raise regional tensions [11,24,35].
